description: A SvelteKit app like the Translations Editor (hash router, one layout around the pages, <svelte:head> titles, app.html attributes): the start at /, link clicks (Kit navigates after a frame and a timer), the layout keeping its instance and state across navigations, the page's reactive title, $app/state page (url, route.id, status), an unknown route rendering Kit's default error page through hooks.client's handleError, back and forward, the live-region announcer with the title after each navigation, focus reset to the document start (Tab then reaches the first link)
